result.summary: The page is generally usable, but the right-edge horizontal carousels look visually cut off, making content appear truncated rather than intentionally scrollable. No critical blockers are visible.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel clips the third restaurant card at the right edge, including the truncated name 'Trattoria Piccol…' and delivery text, which can look broken to users.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, a fade/gradient edge, or a visible scroll indicator so clipped cards read as intentional overflow; ensure text truncates with ellipsis within the card rather than by the viewport.

issues.description: The category chip row is also cut off after 'Healthy' with a partially visible next chip at the edge, giving an unfinished appearance.
issues.suggestion: Use horizontal scroll padding, edge fading, or snap behavior so partially visible chips clearly indicate more content.

issues.description: The notification bell icon has a very small red dot that may be easy to miss and has no visible unread count/context.
issues.suggestion: Increase the badge size or add an accessible label/count for notifications.
